validity.researcher_notes: Length arithmetic exactly supports the staged duplicate: P4099 LengthKnown 68.16 km + P4100 LengthKnown 77.3 km = 145.46 km, which is an EXACT match to this row's LengthKnown (145.46 km) — a strong signal the aggregate row and its two 'halves' were digitized from the same physical corridor. One open wrinkle worth a human's attention when adjudicating: P4099/P4100 are both digitized at 24" while this aggregate row is digitized at 36" — could be a genuinely larger-diameter trunk segment distinct from two smaller laterals, or could simply be a second, inconsistent digitizing pass over the same line (the SNGPL/PEPL source maps are cartographic, not textual, per the standing escalation, so diameter reads are exactly the kind of value likely to vary between two passes over one map). Not resolving it here per the brief's instruction not to re-litigate the staged duplicate call.
